== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Kessel Surveillance System (Errata)]] (Virtual Block 7.3), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text; the other versions of the card are [[Kessel Surveillance System (Errata)|Kessel Surveillance System]] (original); [[Kessel Surveillance System (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive), unchanged in every capture to 11 January 2013. The card list writes icons out; icons are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on a Kessel site. Opponents Force drains are -1 here. Oncer per turn, if you just lost a card from Reserve Deck, may place a 'spice' card in owners Lost Pile to satisfy 1 additional Force loss. Once per game, may deploy Spice Mine Administrator here.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1007_L6459</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>1_204</code>, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 7 set mark) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.

'''Renamed 11 November 2026 (Batch B41b):''' from VB7-00-Kessel_Surveillance_System-PC-E2-cardmaker.png; the version it shows is now E3 (a forum post and its re-made sheet, and each card-list repeat, are versions of their own; Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026).
